name: Spicy Black Bean-Avocado Tacos with Lime Crema & Cilantro-Cabbage Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the limes into a small bowl. Add yogurt and salt, then whisk to combine. Add water, a few teaspoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set crema aside. (Reserve remaining limes for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved limes into a large bowl. Add oil and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the cores; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cumin; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add beans, hot sauce, and salt to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp hot sauce
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Season with salt.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then top with beans, avocado, crema, and reserved cilantro. Serve with slaw on the side and enjoy!
